sources.label: KK Yap & Associates XSGD SCS Reserve Account Report — 31 May 2026

reserveReview.rationale: KK Yap & Associates' independent SSAE 3000 (Revised) examination reports SGD 15,013,117 cash and SGD 11,569,694 short-dated MAS/government bills or eligible overnight reverse repos, against SGD 26,582,811 total reserves. Percentages are calculated against that reported reserve total. The report confirms that the assets are held in a trust account with an MAS-permitted safeguarding institution, but it does not split the second reported category between bills and overnight reverse repos or identify the institution.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KK Yap & Associates independent examination as of 31 May 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The independent examination discloses the complete current reserve allocation between cash and a defined short-dated MAS/government-bill or eligible overnight-repo category. It does not split that second category between bills and repos, identify the safeguarding institution, or publish provider-level allocation.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: SGD cash is an external fiat reserve asset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Short-dated MAS/government SGD bills or eligible overnight reverse repos
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The independent report identifies this as a permitted SGD sovereign-bill or highly rated overnight reverse-repo reserve category; neither component is a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: StraitsX names CIMB, DBS, and Standard Chartered Singapore and permits other MAS-approved institutions, but does not publish provider shares, the current complete provider set, or rehypothecation terms. The trust structure and exclusion from the issuer's unsecured-creditor estate are explicit.
